claims.claim: SGLang documents model-specific tool-call parsers and OpenAI-compatible tool calling, including incremental streaming examples.
claims.locator: Tool parser overview and supported parser list

claims.claim: FunctionCallParser maps parser names to detector classes and selects a detector using tools, tokenizer, tool choice and constrained-mode context.
The streaming wrapper forwards chunks to detector.parse_streaming_increment and flushes detector state at stream end.
BaseFormatDetector buffers partial tool markers, incrementally parses JSON and documents formats that require custom streaming detector implementations.
claims.locator: Partial marker buffering and incremental parse logic

claims.claim: Serving Chat processes reasoning deltas before tool-call streaming and flushes remaining tool arguments when generation finishes.
claims.locator: Streaming reasoning and tool-call SSE handling

claims.claim: Toolformer models tool selection, API argument generation and incorporation of tool results as a learned language-model capability.
Gorilla studies accurate API-call generation and retrieval-aware adaptation to changing API documentation and versions.
